lessons.rootCause: Literal future {{module.field}} mappings embedded inside generator code are prevalidated as references in the current generator scenario.
lessons.fix: Construct future mapping tokens at runtime; keep literal mappings only for modules that exist in the generator.
lessons.evidence: Generator run 7864154d78cc4a94a5805b6b4e8e5851 failed validation; after runtime mapping construction, addaff55c3fd4d0498f727e096bab80c returned PARITY_BLUEPRINT_READY with scorer lengths 10145 and 3254.
lessons.prevention: Separate generator-time mappings from generated-scenario mappings.

lessons.rootCause: Production scorers may reference legacy fallback fields no longer present in live Notion schema.
lessons.fix: Projection = scorer dependencies intersect current schema properties, plus current identity/idempotency fields.
lessons.evidence: 437 live properties; one missing scorer dependency Action Score. Including it caused 400 in 8a74d36936f6461c8c33698f9d914cec; removing only it produced 86c800afaa6d46328cdf471734cb8ea2 at 2 ops/3 credits/45635 bytes.

lessons.fix: Read /v2/scenarios/{id}/blueprint and copy long business scorers byte-for-byte; never reconstruct from snippets.
lessons.evidence: BG89 scorer code lengths 10145 and 3254 extracted from official blueprint and reused in generated parity harness.
lessons.prevention: Source parity is blueprint-derived and code-length/hash checked.

lessons.rootCause: A production row enriched after the original run is no longer the same scorer input.
lessons.fix: Compare projected and full representations of the same pre-write input within one no-write execution.
lessons.evidence: Historic David Kriška replay diverged after BG89 enrichment; fixture strategy was rejected and scenario deactivated.
lessons.prevention: Use same-run A/B or immutable pre-write snapshots.

lessons.symptom: SQL query using UI date property name Opportunity Updated fails no-such-column.
lessons.rootCause: Notion SQL exposes date properties as date:<name>:start, date:<name>:end and date:<name>:is_datetime; the main UI property name is not queryable.
lessons.fix: Fetch the data-source schema first and query "date:Opportunity Updated:start" IS NULL.
lessons.evidence: Initial SQL returned validation_error; fetched schema explicitly documented expanded columns; corrected query returned real unscored DM rows.
lessons.prevention: Never guess SQL column names from Notion UI labels; fetch querySqlColumns first.

lessons.symptom: Operational LinkedIn network_snapshot rows received Opportunity scores, action deadlines, recommendations and attribution fields from BG89.
lessons.rootCause: BG89 filter tried to read the Interactie title property with rich_text[].plain_text. That condition was semantically dead, so rows with title 'Cockpit action | network_snapshot |' passed. Their stable machine identity is Interaction Key network-*.
lessons.failedApproach: Classify operational records by a title field while reading it through the wrong Notion property type.
lessons.fix: Gate on type-correct stable machine identity: Interaction Key rich_text must not contain network-. Production filter readback at lastEdit 2026-08-30T21:29:30.218Z confirms the new condition.

protected_rule: Shadow scenarios stay no-write and inactive/on-demand until exact parity is proven. Operational/control record classes are never allowed through generic commercial writebacks. Production ownership does not move on read/query success alone.
